name: Not So Easy Wall Hop Obby
desc:
✨ Welcome to Not So Easy Wall Hop Obby!

Master the art of wallhopping and test your precision in this skill-based obby! This game uses the classic Roblox wallhop glitch — perfect for hardcore parkour fans looking for a challenge.

🎯 100 Stages across 10 Difficulty Levels. From simple bounces to nearly impossible climbs. The farther you go, the tougher it gets!

😈 TROLL Your Friends
Use the Troll Tool to mess with your friends while they try to concentrate!

✨ Join the group for a FREE SKIP:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/34569389

💀 Stuck? Hit R to instantly reset and go again, no waiting around!

👍 If you’re having fun, don’t forget to Like & Favorite the game, it really helps!
